integrity: Finite exhaustive computations corroborate the theorem but do not prove its infinite range. All mathematical conclusions are supported by a stated deterministic and probabilistic proof; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Results hold for exact single-position deletion and cyclic rotation only; the source is uniform among indexed words, not uniform among necklaces. The total variation estimate is nonsharp and only yields its stated algebraic rate for sufficiently large n with a log-length factor. No exact finite-n shadow histogram, multi-deletion theorem, or deletion-output probability mass law is asserted. Earlier unindexed equivalent work remains a priority risk.
title: Short-factor uniqueness makes circular one-deletion shadows asymptotically run-exact
